# contabo_dns_record (Resource)

Manage a record in a DNS zone hosted on the Contabo name servers. Supported record types are A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, MX, SRV and TXT. The NS and SOA records of a zone are managed by Contabo.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure your Contabo API credentials
provider "contabo" {
  oauth2_client_id     = "[your client id]"
  oauth2_client_secret = "[your client secret]"
  oauth2_user          = "[your username]"
  oauth2_pass          = "[your password]"
}

resource "contabo_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
}

# A record for www.example.com
resource "contabo_dns_record" "www" {
  zone_name = contabo_dns_zone.example.zone_name
  name      = "www"
  type      = "A"
  ttl       = 3600
  data      = "203.0.113.10"
}

# CNAME record pointing to www.example.com
resource "contabo_dns_record" "blog" {
  zone_name = contabo_dns_zone.example.zone_name
  name      = "blog"
  type      = "CNAME"
  data      = "www.example.com"
}

# MX record at the zone apex
resource "contabo_dns_record" "mx" {
  zone_name = contabo_dns_zone.example.zone_name
  name      = "@"
  type      = "MX"
  priority  = 10
  data      = "mail.example.com"
}

# TXT record at the zone apex
resource "contabo_dns_record" "spf" {
  zone_name = contabo_dns_zone.example.zone_name
  type      = "TXT"
  data      = "v=spf1 mx -all"
}

# SRV record
resource "contabo_dns_record" "sip" {
  zone_name = contabo_dns_zone.example.zone_name
  name      = "_sip._tcp"
  type      = "SRV"
  priority  = 10
  weight    = 5
  port      = 5060
  data      = "sip.example.com"
}

# CAA record
resource "contabo_dns_record" "caa" {
  zone_name = contabo_dns_zone.example.zone_name
  type      = "CAA"
  flag      = 0
  tag       = "issue"
  data      = "letsencrypt.org"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) The record value, e.g. an IP address for `A`/`AAAA` records, a host name for `CNAME`, `MX` and `SRV` records, the text for `TXT` records or the CAA value.
- `type` (String) The record type. One of `A`, `AAAA`, `CAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `SRV`, `TXT`.
- `zone_name` (String) The name of the zone the record belongs to.

### Optional

- `flag` (Number) The flag of the record. Only applies to `CAA` records.
- `name` (String) The record name relative to the zone, e.g. `www`. Leave empty or use `@` for the zone apex. A fully qualified name inside the zone is accepted as well.
- `port` (Number) The port of the service. Only applies to `SRV` records.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the record. Only applies to `MX` and `SRV` records.
- `tag` (String) The property tag of the record, one of `issue`, `issuewild` or `iodef`. Required for `CAA` records and only applies to them.
- `ttl` (Number) The time to live of the record in seconds.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the record. Only applies to `SRV` records.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) The fully qualified name of the record.
- `id` (String) The identifier of the record in the form `<zone_name>/<record_id>`. Use it to import an existing record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# DNS records can be imported using <zone_name>/<record_id>
terraform import contabo_dns_record.www example.com/12345678
```
